post.description: Creates a password reset link valid 24 hours for the user and answers it, once: only the hash of its token is stored. The earlier links of the user stop working. The admin never sets nor sees the password. An account being deleted answers 409 `user_deleting`.

schema.description: The id of the user.

put.description: Sets the role of the user and returns the user. A change revokes every session of the user, so that they log in again with a new session. Demoting the last active admin answers 409 `last_admin`, and a change of an account being deleted 409 `user_deleting`.

schema.description: The id of the user.

put.summary: Change the role of a user

put.description: Sets the status of the user and returns the user. Disabling revokes every session of the user at once, and their logins fail until they are active again. Disabling the last active admin answers 409 `last_admin`, and a change of an account being deleted 409 `user_deleting`.

schema.description: The id of the user.

post.description: Logs in with a username or an email and a password, and sets the session cookie. A session that the request already has is replaced. Every failure answers 401 `invalid_credentials`. After 5 failures for one login, or 20 for one client IP, attempts answer 429 `rate_limited` with `Retry-After` in seconds, the delay doubling from 1 second up to 15 minutes.

schema.description: The session cookie.

post.description: Deletes the session of the request and clears the session cookie, even without a session.

schema.description: The session cookie, cleared.

get.description: Returns the user of the session.

post.description: Creates the account of the invitation with the password, marks the invitation used, opens the session and sets the session cookie. A used, expired or unknown invitation answers 410 `invitation_invalid`. A password that breaks the rules answers 422 with the code of the rule: `password_too_short`, `password_too_long` or `password_too_common`, and the invitation stays valid. A username or email that a user took since the invitation answers 409 `username_taken` or `email_taken`. It needs no authentication.

schema.description: The session cookie.

post.description: Returns the username and the expiry of the invitation of the token, which the body carries so that it never reaches a log. A used, expired or unknown invitation answers 410 `invitation_invalid`. It needs no authentication.

get.description: Returns the name of the application and the build metadata of the server, without authentication.

post.description: Replaces the password of the user of the reset link, marks the link used and revokes every session of the user, who then logs in with the new password. The token is in the body so that it never reaches a log. A link used, expired, unknown, replaced by a newer one or of an account being deleted answers 410 `reset_link_invalid`. A password that breaks the rules answers 422 with the code of the rule: `password_too_short`, `password_too_long` or `password_too_common`, and the link stays valid. It needs no authentication.

get.description: Tells whether the instance has no user yet, so that the first admin must be created with the setup token. It needs no authentication.

post.description: Creates the first admin with the setup token, opens their session and sets the session cookie. Once a user exists, whatever the token, it answers 409 `setup_completed`. A wrong token answers 403 `setup_token_invalid`. A username or password that breaks the rules answers 422 with the code of the rule: `username_invalid`, `password_too_short`, `password_too_long` or `password_too_common`.

schema.description: The session cookie.
